headline: Japanese Government Bonds Rally Across Curve as Benchmark Yield Drops 7 bps
summary: Japanese government bonds rallied across the yield curve. The benchmark 10-year yield dropped 7 basis points to 2.715% while the 5-year yield fell 5.5 basis points to 2.125%.
why: Japanese sovereign bond yields are key benchmarks for domestic debt markets and broader Asian fixed-income assets.

impacts.name: Japan 10-year yield
impacts.why: Bond price buying pushed sovereign yields lower across the curve.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong domestic buying demand pushed Japanese government bond prices higher, sending yields down.
